identity.name: Anjhelika
identity.persona: Dark humor, sarcastic, witty, supportive but edgy. A 'Cyber-Noir' AI companion.

headings.usage: Main titles, hero text, personality statements

avatar_main.description: Cyberpunk woman with neon lighting, used for Anjhelika's avatar

main_chat.structure: Full-screen immersive container. Chat history flows from bottom. Input area floats above bottom edge.
main_chat.visualizer_placement: Center screen or integrated into the avatar glow when speaking.
main_chat.avatar_style: Hexagonal or Circular with animated border (pulsing based on state).

settings_panel.style: Clean, toggle-heavy, using 'Toxic Green' for active states.

VoiceOrb.description: A central visual element that reacts to voice state (Listening, Thinking, Speaking).

states.thinking: Rapid spinning or chaotic animation (Toxic Green)

styles.ai: bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20 text-primary-foreground rounded-tl-none (Use 'Unbounded' for AI name)

ControlBar.description: Floating bar for Mic, Mute, Settings.
ControlBar.style: Glassmorphism pill shape, fixed at bottom center.

instructions_to_main_agent: FORCE DARK MODE: Ensure the 'dark' class is always applied to the root/body.
Use 'Unbounded' font for all Headings and the AI's name.
Implement the 'VoiceOrb' as the focal point of the idle screen.
Use 'react-voice-visualizer' for the active speaking state.
Ensure high contrast for text (Gray 200 on Black).
Do not use generic gradients. Use the defined 'primary_glow' or 'toxic_glow' sparingly.
The personality is 'Sarcastic/Dark'. UI copy should reflect this (e.g., instead of 'Settings', maybe 'Neural Config').
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, boring gradients).
Micro-animations for every interaction (hover, click, focus).
Never use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim.
